thesis: A secret you lend, not one you leave lying around. Haven never shows you a padlock — it shows you a lease: a ring that starts full and visibly runs down, because the thing that makes a vault trustworthy isn't that it hides values, it's that it gives them back on a clock. Every section re-enters the same ring device from a different angle instead of illustrating 'security' with a generic shield.

macrostructure.name: Lease
macrostructure.reason: Per page-structures.md, the shape should follow the brief's center of gravity — for a wary, mechanism-literal audience that's an artifact to inspect (a live lease, a real log line), not a claim to read. The page is built around one concrete specimen (a lease card with a depleting ring) rather than a padlock hero image.

signature_spatial_move: A circular countdown ring — thin stroke, starts fully closed, depletes clockwise — is the one recurring device: full-size on the hero's lease-card specimen (with a live countdown), redrawn as four progressively-emptying rings marking the steps of 'how a lease works', and shrunk to a small inline ring badge next to every row of the access-log specimen showing that row's remaining time at a glance.
whitespace_strategy: Gallery-mode airiness (64–112px section gaps) in the marketing bands (hero, proof strip, CTA), collapsing to a tight/dense rhythm (4/8px) inside the lease-card and access-log specimens — spacing itself argues the marketing breathes while the product stays exact.
avoided_template: The security-cliché hero (stock padlock/shield illustration, centered) and the generic SaaS attractor (gradient blob + three identical feature cards + four-column footer). Rejected in favor of an asymmetric hero built around a real lease specimen, a genuine dense access-log instead of a marketing screenshot, and layout variation section to section (see structure).

surface_ramp: #171510 overlay-on-dark (sticky nav after scroll only, near-solid)
color_system.accent: #b1502c warm terracotta/rust — chosen outside the indigo/violet 270-330deg 'AI glow' band and away from generic security blue; reads as a deliberate, warm brand color for a place of shelter, not a corporate lock icon
color_system.status_active: #1f6f66 deep teal-green — lease is currently granted/valid
color_system.status_expiring: #a9791f muted gold — lease has under 10% of its ring left
color_system.status_expired: #8a8577 neutral stone — lease has closed; value is gone

families.display_and_body: system-ui sans stack (-apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif) — no remote fonts permitted
families.mono: ui-monospace / SFMono stack (SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace) — reserved for secret values, lease IDs, timestamps, and the access-log specimen

type_system.note: steps derived from base 17 * 1.333^n, rounded to clean integers for legibility
type_system.case_rule: roman display only (no italic headings); all-caps reserved for short kicker/status labels, never running text; those labels keep line-height >= 1.0

spacing_system.density_by_zone: airy on marketing bands; dense (4/8px) inside the lease-card and access-log specimens — a declared exception per taste-rubric Axis 3

motion_system.hero_device: the lease ring's stroke-dashoffset animates from closed to ~62% over 8s ease-linear-loop (a countdown reads correctly only at constant rate; entrance/state transitions elsewhere are never linear)
motion_system.interactive: hover/focus transitions 160-200ms ease-out on transform/opacity/color only, never width/height; focus ring appears instantly, never transitions in
motion_system.entrance: sections fade + rise 12px on scroll via IntersectionObserver, staggered ~50ms per item, ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 320ms cap
motion_system.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion collapses the ring loop to a static ~62%-depleted state and disables scroll-entrance transforms (content renders in its final state immediately); hover/focus transitions shorten to ~80ms but are not removed

icon_system.family: one hand-authored line-icon set, 24x24 viewBox, 1.75px stroke, round joins/caps — no emoji, no mixed sets
icon_system.usage: feature bento (3 icons: lease, rotation, audit), timeline steps (4 icons), nav/footer utility icons (menu, external-link)

ramp: raised (soft terracotta-tinted shadow, no border — reserved for the hero lease-card and the active reveal state)
overlay (border + near-solid tint, sticky nav only after scroll)
depth_system.shadow_recipe: background-tinted (warm stone/terracotta, never pure black), soft single-stop, never doubled with a heavy border on the same surface
depth_system.no_glass: no backdrop-blur anywhere; the sticky nav gains a near-solid paper tint + hairline border only after scroll

structure.intent: wordmark (ring + keyhole mark) + 3 nav links + secondary/primary CTA pair; gains a hairline bottom border + solid paper fill only after scroll (state, not decoration)

kicker label ('secret leasing, not secret sharing') + display headline stating the mechanism + subhead + CTA pair on the left; on the right, a real lease-card specimen — a masked credential, the countdown ring depleting live, and a 'renews/expires in' readout — concrete proof, not an illustration

structure.layout_model: 3-up stat row, thin band, hairline dividers
structure.intent: three measured-sounding claims (median lease length, zero standing credentials, percentage of reads logged) instead of fabricated customer logos

structure.layout_model: bento grid — one large feature (2/3 width) + two stacked (1/3 width)
structure.intent: three concrete mechanisms: scoped time-boxed leases (control), automatic rotation on schedule (upkeep), full access log (accountability) — each grounded in a specific behavior, not an adjective

structure.layout_model: horizontal 4-step timeline strung along four progressively-emptying lease rings, distinct from the bento grid above it
structure.intent: request -> grant -> use -> auto-expire as one continuous depletion; the repeated ring motif is the connective tissue back to the hero, not a new idea invented for its own sake

structure.layout_model: dense specimen table, mono type, tight 4/8px rhythm — a deliberate density break from the airy bands around it
structure.intent: a real-looking access-log with masked secret values, requester, scope, and a small ring badge per row showing remaining lease time — the concrete proof that every read is accounted for

structure.layout_model: editorial asymmetric quote block, oversized quotation glyph as the composition anchor
structure.intent: one illustrative, unattributed-to-any-real-company quote in a generic role only ('Staff SRE, mid-size fintech') — deliberately generic attribution to avoid presenting a fabricated named endorsement as genuine
restate the single primary action once; a lease ring in the corner closes fully, signaling resolution/closure
wordmark, link groups, and a small monospace build line — no vendor, model, or generator name anywhere
